False positive after independent current page, series definition, augmented theorem and Arnoldi algorithm review. For k>=1 the theorem gives phi_k(X)w as the top n coordinates of exp(B_k(X,w))(0,e_k). For k=0 let C=diag(X,0)=B_1(X,0). Its powers have top-left block X^j (including C^0), hence the absolutely convergent series gives exp(C)=diag(exp(X),1), and the top n entries of exp(C)(w,0) equal exp(X)w=phi_0(X)w. This also holds for X=0 and for n=0. Alternatively recurrence gives phi_0(X)w=w+phi_1(X)(Xw), obtainable from the theorem with B_1(X,Xw). No B_0 is needed. Thus the page claim that each phi action can be obtained from one augmented exponential is sound; the algorithm is free to evaluate k=0 directly. No page edit is warranted.
